summary: End-to-end validation of the new Student Portal (student login, dashboard, learning gating, profile, documents, activity) and Admin Learning Access (grant/revoke reflection, Grant All, set-password) plus Learning Studio resource creation. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests passed including full security matrix (401 no token, 403 admin-token-on-student, 403 locked resource, 200 granted, /api/media/{id} returns 403 for private files). Frontend: student login (wrong+correct), all 8 tabs, profile-city save persists, learning shows 3 granted+3 locked matching seed, document upload succeeds and appears in list, activity log captures Login/Profile Updated/Resource Opened/Document Uploaded/Access Granted/Revoked. Admin Learning Access search->select->Grant flips to GRANTED, Revoke flips to REVOKED, all data-testids (la-search-input/btn, la-result-*, la-grant-*, la-revoke-*, la-grant-all, la-password-input, la-set-password) present. Admin Learning Studio create via /api/admin/data/learning_resources persists and appears in student view (locked, as expected). Mark-complete increments dashboard progress. Set-password + login-with-new-password + restore all work.

issues: Access Start / Access Expiry use browser-native mm/dd/yyyy date inputs instead of a shadcn Calendar/Popover — inconsistent with rest of the admin UI and locale-sensitive.

action_items: Optional: replace native date inputs on /admin/learning-access (la-start-date, la-expiry-date) with the shadcn Calendar component to match admin design system.
server.py is now ~1900 lines — recommend splitting into routers (student, admin_entitlements, payments, technologies) for maintainability. Not a bug; tech debt.
critical_code_review_comments: Student token check in get_current_student correctly rejects admin-role tokens (403). Good defense-in-depth.
entitlement_active() correctly handles missing entitlement (None), REVOKED status, expired dates, and future start dates.
get_media() 403 on private files verified — protected content is not accessible via public route.
student_upload_doc reads full file into memory (base64 in MongoDB) — acceptable for the 10MB cap but note large-scale users will want GridFS/S3 later.
/api/admin/students/{sid}/set-password enforces min 6 chars but does not require special chars/uppercase — matches seed policy. Acceptable for MVP.
Note the ResourceManager UI at /admin/r/learning_resources uses backend /api/admin/data/learning_resources (generic CRUD) — the URL segments differ (r vs data). Not a bug, just something to remember.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Student Portal tabs + Admin Learning Access flows)
